## Publication Information

**Date:** 1870

**Genre:** Non-fiction: history (by others)

**Publisher:** London and New York: Macmillan and Co.

**Notes:** The first volume of this title is a renamed version of <i>Historical Selections: A Series of Readings from the Best Authorities in English and European History </i>(1868).
